title: Design System: AI Checkout · Catalog review

components.name: Changes Table
components.description: Helios Table: field (row header), published, proposed; hidden caption; scrolls horizontally in its container.

components.name: Inline Alert
components.description: Before you publish (warning), notices (success, role status), failures (critical, role alert).

components.name: Publish Confirmation
components.description: Warning Modal restating revision, counts, expiry and note; focus starts on Cancel; Publish release is the only publishing action.

components.name: Structured Editor
components.description: Per-card Disclosure and per-rule Fieldset of Helios fields with live Zod validation and a preview against the published catalog.

components.name: Capture All Missing Sources
components.description: Load <source id>.txt files or paste text for every uncaptured source; one submit captures and attaches all in one revision.

components.name: Editors Tabs
components.description: Cards and rules / JSON for schema 2 drafts.

components.name: Application State
components.description: Loading, session ended, access required, empty queue.

narrative.overview: The Review Desk is a quiet reading environment built on Helios through packages/ui: white working surfaces on the faint page color, blue for actions, Helios fields, tables, badges, alerts and a confirmation dialog. AI Checkout keeps its own name and cart icon. Changed values stay next to unchanged conditions and exact captured evidence, and publication is a separately confirmed action bound to one revision.
keyCharacteristics: Helios tokens for every color, size, radius and shadow.
Diff-centered review with adjacent evidence (stacked below 1500 px).
Structured per-rule editor validated by the shared Zod schema, beside the JSON editor.
One-step capture of every missing source.
Publish confirmation dialog with focus on Cancel.
Axe-clean at 1280 and 390 px; CSP without inline exceptions.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Use --token-* variables and @ai-checkout/ui components; no raw values.

rules.name: The Evidence Adjacency Rule
rules.body: Keep changed values next to unchanged conditions and captured evidence.

rules.name: The Separate Approval Rule
rules.body: Publication is a separately confirmed human action bound to one revision; the dialog starts on Cancel.

rules.name: The No-Inline Rule
rules.body: The CSP forbids inline styles, inline scripts and eval; zod runs jitless.

dos: Show the exact source text and dates beside the rules.
Validate structured edits with the shared schema.
donts: Don't imply matching text proves an interpretation.
Don't add inline styles or scripts.
Don't publish without the confirmation dialog.
